_readme: Enforcement constants for the Rule B exception to the Tier-3 locale default (owner decision 2026-11-26). A Tier-3 locale stays Tier 3 in data/locale_qualification_tiers.json; this exception authorizes ONE page in ONE existing locale, never a language or a whole family. It is read by scripts/lib/locale-parent-registry.js (ruleBException, validateRuleBEntries) and enforced by scripts/check-locale-parent-gap.js. The authorizing record for each page is a data/locale_parent_gap_audit.json entry with scope "page", pattern = the reference page's path without index.html (e.g. "library/heart-symbols"), and verdict "rule-b-exception" (Rule B + positive target-language evidence) or "rule-b-experiment" (Rule B + insufficient target-language evidence, inside a bounded experimental allowance below). Negative target-language evidence never passes. A locale with no tier entry is a new-locale launch and stays an owner decision; a held locale stays held; a script-incompatible parent stays blocked. Revenue protection, canonical-intent, cannibalization, translation-quality, parity and release gates apply unchanged. Do not raise a cap or add an allowance without a dated owner decision.

decision.summary: Rule A only keeps the tier restriction. Rule B + positive target-language evidence authorizes an individual translation in an existing locale. Rule B + insufficient target-language evidence is eligible for a bounded experimental cohort. Rule B + negative target-language evidence is held. A new locale launch keeps owner approval. Unresolved technical prerequisites stay blocked.

EXP-20261126.note: Up to 30 translations with strong cross-language (Rule B) evidence and insufficient target-language measurement, ranked by market evidence and expected usefulness. Never overrides negative evidence or a technical blocker.
